devicesMFE.py.summary: DevicesMFE is a Page Object Model class for HP Smart web application's device management micro-frontend. It inherits from SmartFlow and provides comprehensive test automation methods organized into verification flows and action flows. Notable patterns include: (1) Extensive use of wait_for_object with configurable timeouts and exception handling for robust element synchronization, (2) Verification methods that check element visibility states (visible/invisible) to confirm UI state, (3) Alpha code workarounds for Windows dummy printer testing using XML file approach, (4) Multi-screen popup navigation support for HPX What's New onboarding flow with dedicated getter and verification methods for each screen, (5) JavaScript executor usage for clicking hidden elements (account panel close button), (6) Keyboard automation using Selenium Keys for page refresh (Ctrl+R), (7) Separation of concerns with dedicated verification and action method categories, (8) Consistent naming conventions with prefixes (verify_, click_, get_) for method categorization, (9) Support for both logged-in and logged-out user states, and (10) Comprehensive coverage of device card interactions, navigation elements, and popup management for end-to-end device management workflows.
